convoLines.text: "...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
Something eases in their shoulders. "Oh. Okay. That's... that's fine, then."
"This one is Turmeric. Look at the leaf, feel the stem, breathe it in. It'll stick."
"This one — Wild Garlic. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
Larry looks at you, level. "I told you the truth. You can keep poking it, but it's told."
"We went over this," Larry says, a little tired. "I already told you the truth about that."
"Still on the talking-to-strangers part. Moving on."
"Look at the timing. It arrived when we were weakest, not when we were ready. That's not rescue. That's a controlled experiment with a stress variable."
"I'd love to. Lead the way." (They're already checking your pack.)
You show them Goldenrod — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
"We're done for now. Not done-done. For now."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"Every day it's angrier. I need it cleaned before it turns — I can't work a wound like this. Wrap it tight when you're done."
Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Have you heard what they're calling The Callback? I'm pushing 'Big Ugly'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
"All right. Thank you for telling me."
"Names are for when it's dead or known. Right now it's neither, so I wake before anyone else instead."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Alfredo grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

"We'll land on something. We always do — usually the loudest person's idea."
"Still on what's been happening."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"Okay." Something shutters, just slightly.
"Still on what you dream about."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Good question." "The whole fire was arguing about The Callback last night — what to even CALL it. 'Big Ugly' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
"Take your time."
"I'm staying out of the naming fight. For now. Someone always gets precious about their pick."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Alfredo nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
You show them Goldenrod — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"Well. My social battery is officially dead."
"This was good." They mean it.
"About this wound — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"I still need help with this wound."

"Anyway — that's my problem, not yours. What did you want?"
"Last time things were different. They always are." "We both stood at the treeline. Jalen held it. I keep replaying my part, looking for the step I missed."
"I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
It's quiet at the hollow. Alfredo doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"Like I said — we're still on what's been happening."
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"Good — what's been happening, settled. Feels better said out loud."

"This wound — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"I still need a hand with this wound."
Get to their side of the Haven door and stand next to them — then you can help.

"Jalen always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."

"Alright — I should get back to it."

"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."

"As I said — we're still on what's been happening."

"This one — Black Walnut. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."

"I need the mechanism. Not the story — the mechanism. Stories lie. Mechanisms don't."

"Bulldozer — Lowers its head, paws the earth. It hunts by day — watch the open ground."

"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."
"Since Alfredo died... I keep expecting to see Alfredo at the fire. Stupid."

"I keep turning over the last thing Alfredo said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jalen Fischer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Jalen is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Jalen Fischer is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Jalen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Jalen's gone." Larry looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jalen." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Bogdan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jalen Fischer, 41 days. The mantle passes to Bogdan Lazarev.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Bogdan Lazarev, 38 — a hunting guide. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location, Berserker Rage, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Jalen — and Jalen is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Alfredo, Jorge, Larry and 3 more speak for Bogdan — "Jalen trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Bogdan before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
